title: Glute Kickback Machine
summary: A machine kickback that isolates one glute at a time.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for glutes (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.3 for hamstrings (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Set up on the machine with one foot on the plate or pad.
Push your leg back and up by squeezing your glute.
Return slowly without letting your lower back arch.

form_cues.cue: Drive the foot back and up
Squeeze the glute at the top
Stop when your hip is straight. Going further just bends the lower back.

mistakes.text: Arching the lower back to get more range.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less peak-contraction focus, Both sides together.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less peak-contraction focus, Less isolation.
Swap sheet: Both sides together, More systemic fatigue, Heavier loading potential.
